subject: general
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed in this pattern is based on alphabetical shifts between consecutive letters within each cluster.

**For 'BEH':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e9d00e57de5f3c24fbf1cffcf63edbb327bd7b4fce8706dfeac58c4e311b093.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be59fdd93a858064a662f9cc24212233f0677e86159588fe00e2a75a277dee02.png] 

**For 'FHL':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82fd1fe7dfec792f966c4d5fa1dd2f1db17be3cffee8c4ebc3b453d8cc0107f7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4a06b68099d6f56c2dac11f27a8f93baf706fef68b41298e3bdc76d9b997f4e.png] 

**For 'ACG':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70a0a9806aa72ecd6aaf0aef28eb87cd977ec242d9477ac450734b9ded735184.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e4d9fc652ef0da62e32f864df1821c9cd204a9aa44c70308ff6506373980225.png] 

**For 'SUY':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8903489ba36db1b86dc2dc8c64d0416fc129b6efc5bcb989af610946dcb5930.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/910e931c48bc824a7a8aa62aa130bc6a6bfc6ddd44164c13e20f3f6c1c9386d7.png] 

All letter-clusters except 'BEH' follow the pattern of adding +2 to the first letter to get the second, and adding +4 to the second letter to get the third.

'BEH' follows a +3, +3 pattern.

Hence, the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group is** "1) BEH".**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
